meta.title: Room booking
meta.description: Borrow the multipurpose hall or classroom at Al Muttaqin Cultural Center for akad nikah, aqiqah, seminars, and meetings.

title: Use the mosque
description: The hall and classroom are available to the congregation free of charge for weddings, aqiqah, seminars, and meetings. Requests are confirmed by the committee within two working days.

rooms.title: Spaces you
rooms.description: Choose the room that fits your group. Capacity is the maximum number of people the room can hold safely.

1.title: Free for the congregation
1.text: There is no rental fee. Voluntary infaq for electricity and cleaning is welcome.

2.title: Voluntary infaq
2.text: Any amount is appreciated and goes to the mosque's operating fund.

3.title: No loud music
3.text: Nasheed and speeches are fine; keep volume respectful of prayers and neighbours.

4.title: Clean up after use
4.text: Return chairs and carpets, take rubbish with you, and leave the kitchen as you found it.

5.title: Finish by 22:00
5.text: Events end by 22:00 so the building can be locked after Isha.

availability.title: Confirmed within two working days
availability.body: We do not show a live calendar yet. Send your request and the committee will check the schedule and reply by WhatsApp or email.
availability.hours: Available daily, 08:00 to 22:00, outside prayer times

form.title: Booking request
form.description: Fill in the details and we will confirm availability.
form.contactHint: We will reply here to confirm.
form.notesPlaceholder: Set-up needs, catering, or anything else.

success.title: Request received
success.body: Thank you. The committee will confirm availability within two working days.

fallback.title: One more step
fallback.body: Online storage is not active yet. Tap the button to send your request to the committee on WhatsApp; the message is ready.
